content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says to rejoice how often?
explanation: Joy is for every day. “Rejoice at all times.” (1 Thessalonians 5:16, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says to pray how?
explanation: Stay close to God always. “Pray without ceasing.” (1 Thessalonians 5:17, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, in what circumstances should we give thanks?
explanation: This is God's will for you. “Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.” (1 Thessalonians 5:18, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, the Day of the Lord will come like what?
explanation: No one knows the hour. “the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.” (1 Thessalonians 5:2, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, where will believers meet the Lord when He comes?
explanation: We will always be with the Lord. “to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.” (1 Thessalonians 4:17, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul tells believers to encourage and do what to one another?
explanation: They were already doing it. “Therefore encourage and build one another up” (1 Thessalonians 5:11, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, after describing the Lord's coming, what does Paul say to do with these words?
explanation: They bring hope. “Therefore encourage one another with these words.” (1 Thessalonians 4:18, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, after testing all things, what should you hold fast to?
explanation: Avoid every form of evil. “but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.” (1 Thessalonians 5:21, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, why did Paul write about those who sleep in death?
explanation: Believers have hope. “so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.” (1 Thessalonians 4:13, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, who will rise first when the Lord descends?
explanation: Then the living will be caught up. “and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.” (1 Thessalonians 4:16, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, which instrument of God will sound when the Lord descends?
explanation: With the voice of an archangel. “and with the trumpet of God” (1 Thessalonians 4:16, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says he was gentle among them like whom?
explanation: He cared deeply for them. “we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.” (1 Thessalonians 2:7, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul remembers their work of faith and labor of what?
explanation: And their enduring hope. “your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope” (1 Thessalonians 1:3, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul urges believers to work with their own what?
explanation: Live quietly. “and to work with your own hands” (1 Thessalonians 4:11, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, from what should believers abstain?
explanation: Hold fast to good. “Abstain from every form of evil.” (1 Thessalonians 5:22, BSB)

content: Besides Paul and Timothy, who sent 1 Thessalonians?
explanation: Silvanus is also called Silas. “Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians” (1 Thessalonians 1:1, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, whom did Paul send to strengthen the believers' faith?
explanation: He was Paul's fellow worker. “We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God” (1 Thessalonians 3:2, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, whose voice will be heard when the Lord descends?
explanation: With a loud command. “with the voice of an archangel” (1 Thessalonians 4:16, BSB)

content: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul urges believers to aspire to live how?
explanation: Mind your own matters. “and to aspire to live quietly” (1 Thessalonians 4:11, BSB)
